text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, good talk at the dorm leader meeting today, Hishiama! Now then…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one and… zero. It's now officially after curfew!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: A'ight, let's catch ourselves a good haul of stragglers today!

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff! F-Fuji! Sorry we're late!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Curfew was twenty minutes ago. Did something happen to keep you all out?

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: W-well, no… We just got caught up while chatting and lost track of time. We're really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your honesty. It's fine to enjoy company with friends, but be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I think of all you darling ponies wandering about so late at night, why, I find myself simply overcome with distress!

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Okay! We'll be better next time, promise!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh. I'm not sure if I'd call that a slap on the wrist or a kiss on the cheek. They aren't gonna learn if you don't scare 'em good.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Your no-nonsense approach certainly keeps your residents in line, that's for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But the moment I saw them running up, breathless with apology, I knew they were sincerely sorry.

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Delinquent
text_block_list.text: There you are! Yo, Fuji! What the hell's with this thing?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What the… What is that? Hang on, is that a plush of you, Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Delinquent
text_block_list.text: The minute it hit eight o'clock, it started blasting out these super cringe lines, and I couldn't turn it off!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Plush
text_block_list.text: "Oh, my darling, are you not home yet? Hurry back! I miss you so, my sweet pony!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Don't tell me you don't like my little gift!

text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Delinquent
text_block_list.text: When did you even put this in my bag?! Ugh, I get it already! I'll stop breaking curfew, all right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's the weirdest disciplinary method I've ever seen, but eh… Suits you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, being able to provide exactly what is needed is the noble work of an entertainer, after all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oops, it's nearly nine. We should head back soon too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh… Brian! Just what time do you think it is right now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Dunno. Wasn't paying attention.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wish you would, though. It's not hard to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Whatever. I'm going to sleep. Bye.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, Brian! I'm not do—hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …So that's what happened last night.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Brian is such a tough nut to crack. I don't know what to do with her.
choice_data_list: You might have to switch up the way you talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But how? What do you think would work?
choice_data_list: You have to be fierce like Hishi Amazon!
You have to be strict like Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I think I know what you mean! Heheh, that might actually work. I'll give it a shot!
The next night, Narita Brian once again returns past curfew.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon(?)
text_block_list.text: You there! Brian! And just what time do ya think it is right now?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ama?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Wait, it's just you! Stop messing with me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Get back here! I let it slide last time, but you're not gettin' away this time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If you aren't gonna listen to me, then let's settle things with a one-on-one race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh, quit it with your stupid impersonation! Ama's not even like that! She's more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Sigh. Never mind. I don't have the energy for this…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll be more careful about curfew, all right? You happy?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh! That really worked! ♪
Fuji Kiseki manages to maintain her dignity as dorm leader and add a new personality to her repertoire of characters.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She does get pretty intense when she chides us during student council meetings… I'll give it a try! Playing the Empress should be good practice!
The next night, Narita Brian once again returns past curfew.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove(?)
text_block_list.text: You! Just what do you think you're doing still out? Do you have any idea what time it is?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ack, Air Groove?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh, it's just Fuji Kiseki… Wait, Fuji Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare run. Upon my pride as Empress, I'll drill into your head the vital importance of punctuality!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ngh… What is this pressure I'm feeling?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Argh, enough already! This is more trouble than it's worth!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Look, I'll be more careful about curfew, so get off my back already.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh! That really worked! ♪
Fuji Kiseki manages to maintain her dignity as dorm leader and add a new personality to her repertoire of characters.
